_README: Round 2 of an agent loop: one passage per holdout question, written after reading the question and its round-1 results (original + hyde_holdout passage, fused, top 4: regulation, subject, article), never the label. Where round 1 found the law, the passage mirrors its title and the point asked; where it looked wrong, the passage redirects. s133 s147 s164 n105 s332 s281 were written after their labels had been seen in a diagnosis: report the score without them too.
